title: Symbol instances end-to-end: model, rendering, placement, edit-in-place
description: The core authoring flow (draw -> F8 convert to symbol -> edit inside -> place instances) is impossible. Gaps: (1) SymbolInstance is a stub with only id/symbolId/x/y (packages/core/src/engine/types.ts:228-234) — needs scale, rotation, color effect (alpha/tint), filters, graphic loop mode per docs/07 and docs/02; (2) CanvasRenderer skips instance objects entirely (renderer.ts:445-448) — render the symbol timeline content recursively; instances currently draw as 60x40 blue placeholder divs in StageArea; (3) Create New Symbol makes an empty husk and Edit in Place only sets a breadcrumb — StageArea keeps editing the document timeline; edit context must swap the timeline being edited to the symbol timeline (Shell.tsx:621-632, also fix setEditContext being called inside a setLibrary updater — impure updater double-fires under StrictMode); (4) no Convert to Symbol (F8) command at all; add Insert/Modify menu items. Depends on 0051-shell-document-owner for instances living in the timeline. Motion tweens (docs/02) target instances, so this blocks tween authoring.
